title: Design From Labs component sidecar (meta.json)
description: Gallery metadata for one component in content/components/<source-id>/<component>/meta.json. Contract: docs/contract.md. The registry items themselves are shadcn registry-item.json files (schemas/labs-registry-item.schema.json).

schemaVersion.description: The contract version this file follows.

name.description: The component slug. Must equal the directory name and be unique across every source.

description.description: One or two plain sentences. Shown on the gallery tile, the component page, llms.txt and the registry item.

status.description: Only ready publishes (site page, /r/*.json, the npm library and llms.txt). draft and beta are validated but not published; deprecated is withdrawn from publishing.

label.description: Optional collection label shown on the tile, e.g. "Labs examples".

variants.description: Every registry item of this component. Each needs items/<name>.json. A component that renders icons ships every style in both icon sets.

defaultVariant.description: The variant shown first; must be one of variants[].name.

demo.description: The gallery demo: a .tsx file (relative to the component directory) whose default export renders the component with no props. Either one path for every variant, or a map from variant name to path with "*" as the fallback.

preview.description: A compressed WebP or AVIF still in the component directory, at most 200 KB, 1200x750 recommended.

repo.description: A public https repository URL, or the literal "private source" for an approved private source (never a private URL or path).

commit.description: The full commit SHA the export or fetch was taken from.

path.description: Optional path inside a PUBLIC source. Omit for a private source.

license.description: An SPDX identifier on the redistribution allowlist (docs/contract.md, Licenses). scripts/check-licenses.mjs refuses anything else.

attribution.description: The notice the license requires to travel with the code (copyright line and license name). Required for every third-party component; the build prints it in each file's header.

credits.description: Source registry ids (docs/sources/registry.yaml) for everything this component uses or derives from: libraries, icon sets, references. At least one.

date.description: The date of the export or the last substantive change (YYYY-MM-DD).

a11y.description: Keyboard, focus, ARIA and motion notes, one sentence each.

usage.description: Optional short TSX usage snippet shown on the page and in llms-full.txt.

label.description: Optional switcher label for the style, e.g. "Subtle".
